description:
Up to 500 domains in one call, answered in the order sent, each with status found, not_found or rejected. NEEDS AN API KEY ON THE PRO PLAN.

include adds sub-lists to every found domain: addresses (the same address objects as domain_detail, with network), certificates, timing. Each one lowers the per-call domain cap because the reply is held in memory; the reply's limit says what applied. A sub-list whose query failed is named in include_failed, so an empty sub-list otherwise means none held.

Use it for a list of known domains; for one domain the free lookup_domain (summary) or domain_detail (full record) is the better call, and for names you only know the shape of use search_domains. not_found means not held, never not registered; rejected means the input was not a valid domain.

domains.description: Domain names, up to 500, answered in the order sent.

include.description: Optional sub-lists for each found domain: addresses (with network), certificates, timing (registration timing). Omit for the summary record only; each one added lowers the per-call cap.

name: lookup_domains
title: Look up many domains at once
